formula: normalized=(15+sum(11 resolved option contributions))/100; High if >0.65, else Medium if >0.40, else Low

tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_back_line: Use the offside trap to try to catch your opponent's players in an offside position, or shadow their progression towards your goal.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_cross_tendency: Determines how often your players will attempt crosses into the box during attacks.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_focus_passing: Focusing on one part of the pitch will motivate your players to organize plays on that side.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_marking_style: Using the man-to-man style gives a defensive boost against faster attacks, and the zonal style does better against longer distance attacks.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_mentality: An offensive mentality leads to more opportunities for attack, but will leave you open to your opponent's counter-attacks.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_passing_style: Choosing short passes will increase the frequency of combination plays, and long passes will lead to more frequent long ball plays.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_possession_lost: Counter-press to regain possession at a risk for your defenses, or regroup your team and prepare for an attack.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_possession_won: Forcing counter-attacks offers a risky way to surprise your opponents, while focusing on buildup, although predictable, yields safer results.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_pressing_style: Different pressing styles help against different actions, but will tire out your players to varying degrees.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_shooting_tendency: Determines whether your players will try to shoot from distance or work the ball closer to the goal before taking a shot.
tooltips.tactics_v2_tooltip_tackling_style: Harder tackling will result in stopping more of your opponent's plays, but could generate more fouls and bookings.
